claim: The playbook treats the host's save as canonical, makes client saving a no-op or separate slot, and uses a full snapshot on join (then deltas) as late-join, reconnect and test oracle.
evidence: networking.md 1.4: saving on a client is 'a no-op or a separate local slot'; how-coop-mods-work 1.8: build snapshot-on-join early.

### 1.4 Saves and level transitions; ### 1.8 Late join

verification_method: Read-only reading of the shallow clone (depth 50) at the stated commit; no code built or run.
limitations: Generic guidance; Gothic 3 example shows saves may need hooking to remove puppet bodies first.
